scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.build:worker: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist

MCP_TOKEN.description: Required: generate your own ASCII token (at least 32 characters), e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`. Used as the MCP Bearer token.

SHOW_IMAGE_CONTENT.description: `true` returns original ImageContent with show_image; `false` returns only card data and links. get always returns the original.

DB.description: D1 database for image names, aliases, descriptions and dimensions. Created automatically; keep the default deploy command to apply migrations.

IMAGES.description: R2 bucket for original image bytes. Enable R2 in your own account before deploying; review Cloudflare billing terms.
